counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Which county rolls to read. Leave empty for all of them.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many matching parcels. Start small while you tune filters — there are 858,000 parcels in total.

requireValidAddress.title: Skip parcels with no street address
requireValidAddress.description: About 5% of a county roll is submerged land, rights of way and drainage tracts with no real address (they appear as "0"). These are excluded by default. Turn this off to get the complete roll.

propertyTypes.title: Property type
propertyTypes.description: Normalised across counties, so 'Single Family' means the same thing everywhere. Leave empty for all types.

absenteeOwnersOnly.title: Absentee owners only
absenteeOwnersOnly.description: Only parcels where the owner's mailing address differs from the property address — the standard signal the owner does not live there.

outOfStateOwnersOnly.title: Out-of-state owners only
outOfStateOwnersOnly.description: Only parcels whose owner receives mail outside Florida.

excludeHomestead.title: Exclude homestead-exempt properties
excludeHomestead.description: Drop parcels with a homestead exemption, i.e. the owner's primary residence. Only some counties publish this flag; parcels without the data are kept.

ownerType.title: Owner type
ownerType.description: Whether the owner looks like a company or trust, or a private individual.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Property city, e.g. TAMPA, BRANDON, RIVERVIEW, NEW PORT RICHEY, WESLEY CHAPEL.

minYearBuilt.title: Built after year
minYearBuilt.description: Only parcels with an actual year built at or after this year.

maxYearBuilt.title: Built before year
maxYearBuilt.description: Only parcels with an actual year built at or before this year.

minLivingAreaSqFt.title: Minimum living area (sq ft)
minLivingAreaSqFt.description: Only parcels with at least this much heated living area.

lastSoldBeforeYear.title: Last sold before year
lastSoldBeforeYear.description: Find long-held property — parcels whose last recorded sale predates this year.

lastSoldAfterYear.title: Last sold after year
lastSoldAfterYear.description: Only parcels sold since this year.
